{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_converted['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_converted)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age:.2f} years")"}
